title: Impact of prescribing nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs in pleurodesis surgery after pneumothorax: a prospective randomized controlled double-blind multicenter noninferiority study
official: Impact of prescribing nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs in pleurodesis surgery after pneumothorax: a prospective randomized controlled double-blind multicenter noninferiority study
summary: Main objective: show the non-inferiority, in terms of drainage time, of NSAIDs after pleurodesis surgery for the cure of pneumothorax
conditions: pleurodesis surgery for cure of pneumothorax
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Pneumothorax for video-exclusive surgical indication With or without minor lung resection (atypical resection)
2. Age > or = 18 years old
3. Written or oral informed consent to participate in the study.
4. Affiliation to a social security scheme
5. Highly effective contraception for women of childbearing age (combined hormonal contraception (estrogen and progesterone) combined with ovulation inhibition (oral, intra-vaginal, transdermal), hormonal contraception (progesterone only) combined with ovulation inhibition (oral, injectable, implantable), intrauterine device, hormone-releasing intrauterine system, bilateral fallopian tube occlusion, vasectomized partner, sexual abstinence, etc.). )
Exclusion criteria:
1. Minor
2. Patient under guardianship, curatorship or deprived of liberty
3. patient who refuses to participate in the study
4. Contraindication to the use of NSAIDs
5. Contraindications to the use of TRAMADOL
6. Curative anticoagulation
7. Contraindications to the use of NEFOPAM
8. Contraindications to the use of PARACETAMOL
9. Contraindications to the use of SODIUM CHLORIDE
10. Lactose intolerance
11. Hemopneumothorax
12. Purulent pleurisy
13. Polytraumatized
14. Pregnant, parturient or breastfeeding patient
